profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Magnetar Capital
profile.summary:
I am excited to apply my skills and passion for technology to deliver innovative solutions. With experience in front-end and back-end development, I am proficient in programming languages such as Python, C#, Rust, and SQL.

I am a dedicated problem solver who enjoys working in collaborative environments to deliver high-quality work that meets project requirements. I am eager to continue learning and staying up-to-date with the latest technologies and techniques to enhance my skills and contribute to the success of my team.

projects.title: FastDate
projects.description: A SIMD vectorized datetime (ISO 8601) parser that is ~7x faster (86% less time) than DateTime.Parse()/ParseExact().

projects.title: LeaderElection
projects.description: An easy-to-use C# implementation of the distributed leader election pattern, leveraging common infrastructure tools like Azure Blob Storage, Redis, and others.
